goal: Compute a reliable set of genomic crossover candidates in the chr22 fixture at trio_dev_data/input using whatshap phase --ped --recombination-list. Decide whether whatshap unphase is needed to avoid mixed phasing, whether to run whatshap stats, and whether to haplotag the BAMs. Report each candidate crossover separately, identifying the trio member, chromosome, and flanking coordinates. Supply an IGV snapshot specification per candidate with the local indexed chr22 FASTA, indexed BAMs used in the audit, the indexed phased VCF.gz if available, and an initial view covering both flanks with surrounding context.
criteria: Audit each crossover candidate against the corresponding read alignments and controller-rendered IGV snapshots of the candidate interval. Request additional views when useful. Determine whether informative spanning alignments support the predicted crossover, accounting for read quality, parental origin, and phasing context. Coverage or haplotags alone do not establish a true crossover.
distill: Distill heuristics about unreliable crossover candidates from the alignment audits. Focus on failure modes that could guide subsequent crossover discovery.
